<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_page"><sp_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><css>/* Tour Travel shared styles. Applied through page-level CSS so the same look
   renders in the Tour Travel portal and in Employee Center (/esc). Colors read
   the platform's Now tokens first and fall back to the Tour Travel palette. */
.tt {
  --tt-primary: var(--now-color--primary-1, #5b3df5);
  --tt-primary-dark: #3b24b8;
  --tt-ink: #1e1b4b;
  --tt-text: #2d2a55;
  --tt-muted: #6b6a8a;
  --tt-line: #e6e4f5;
  --tt-surface: #ffffff;
  --tt-bg: #f6f5fd;
  --tt-radius: 16px;
  --tt-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(30, 27, 75, 0.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(30, 27, 75, 0.06);
  --tt-shadow-hover: 0 2px 4px rgba(30, 27, 75, 0.08), 0 14px 32px rgba(91, 61, 245, 0.16);

  color: var(--tt-text);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  padding: 8px 0 48px;
}
.tt *, .tt *::before, .tt *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
.tt h1, .tt h2, .tt h3, .tt p { margin: 0; }
.tt a { text-decoration: none; }

/* Hero */
.tt-hero {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 24px;
  padding: 48px 40px;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, #1e1b4b 0%, #3b24b8 55%, #5b3df5 100%);
  box-shadow: var(--tt-shadow);
}
.tt-hero::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: -80px;
  top: -80px;
  width: 320px;
  height: 320px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 200, 87, 0.45), rgba(255, 200, 87, 0) 70%);
}
.tt-hero-copy { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 640px; }
.tt-eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.tt-hero-title { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 32px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }
.tt-hero-sub { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); }
.tt-hero-actions { margin-top: 24px; }

/* Buttons */
.tt-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
}
